measures.title: Limestone County: senior property tax exemption (Act 2026-86)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 that applies only to Limestone County. It would let a qualified taxpayer age 65 or older claim a senior property tax exemption on real property under certain conditions.
measures.yesMeans: Qualified Limestone County taxpayers 65 or older could claim a senior property tax exemption on real property under certain conditions.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and this senior exemption does not take effect.
